integrity: The current full primary PDF was inspected at the definitions of sprouts, canonical trees, grafting, buds, petals, Proposition 12.3, the Kruskal step, and the final finite-model proof. The counterexample family is symbolic: cluster multiplicity changes ordinary isomorphism type while leaving height and width zero. The independent 2026 decision-procedure paper was checked only to delimit the claim: IK4's finite model property does not depend solely on the diagnosed construction.
scientific_limitations: The result identifies a finiteness gap in one construction, not a counterexample to Proposition 12.3 itself and not a refutation of the finite model property for IK4. A finite quotient, reduced-petal selection, or simulation-type argument may repair the proof. No claim is made about future versions of the preprint.
title: The all-petals flower need not be finite
